claims.statement: `AIService` (`src/market/ai_service.py`) is the single owner of AI behavior in retail-portfolio: it assembles context from the security, price and note repositories, builds prompts, calls an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint via `AsyncOpenAI`, and is consumed by both the three market-router AI endpoints and the asynchronous note-title Huey task.

The recent-price trend block in `_build_context_prompt` is derived from the 30 stored closes: it prints the first and last close and their percentage change, and is omitted entirely when `recent_prices` is empty.

The three AI endpoints are authenticated `POST` routes rate-limited at `5/minute` and all return `AIAnalysisResponse` (`content`, `generated_at`) with `generated_at` stamped in the router as `datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()`: `/securities/{security_id}/ai/fundamentals`, `/securities/{security_id}/ai/summarize-notes`, and `/securities/{security_id}/ai/portfolio-debate`, the last accepting `AIAnalysisRequest.portfolio_context` and substituting `"No portfolio context provided."` when it is missing.

`summarize_notes` short-circuits to the literal string `"No notes found for this security."` when the gathered context has no notes, so that endpoint performs no provider call and can never return 503 or 504.

`_call_ai_api` issues chat completions with `temperature=0.7`, `max_tokens=2000` and a 60-second default timeout using `self._api_model` (from `settings.ai_api_model`), re-raises any SDK exception as `RuntimeError("AI service unavailable: ...") from None`, raises `RuntimeError` on empty content and `TypeError` on non-string content, and strips DeepSeek-style think blocks with a DOTALL regex before returning the trimmed string.

`generate_note_title` hard-codes `model="gpt-4-turbo"` and ignores `settings.ai_api_model`, and uses `temperature=0.3`, `max_tokens=20`, `timeout=10` — parameters distinct from the 60-second analysis path.

`generate_note_title` enforces `MAX_TITLE_LENGTH = 50` by slicing the result, strips matching surrounding double or single quotes, and swallows every exception to return a fallback derived from the note content (`content[:MAX_TITLE_LENGTH - 3] + "..."` for long content, else the raw content), which is why note creation can never fail because of the AI provider.

Note title generation is asynchronous: `market_create_note` and `market_update_note` persist the note and then enqueue `generate_note_title_task(note_id, request_id=get_request_id())`, returning the note before any title exists.

`_generate_note_title` returns early when `huey.svcs_registry is None`, resolves `SecurityNoteRepository` and `AIService` from a `Container` built on that registry, warns and returns if the note id no longer exists, calls `ai_service.generate_note_title(note.content)`, writes the result via `note_repository.update_title(note_id, title)`, and restores the request-id context var token in a `finally` block.

The worker's `svcs` registry is built on `@huey.on_startup` in `setup_worker_services` with a `NullPool` session manager and the same `register_services` call used by the HTTP process, and Huey is `MemoryHuey` when `settings.environment == "test"` and `RedisHuey` otherwise.

Stub versus real AI selection is a single switch: `register_services` branches on `settings.stub_external_api`, and when `STUB_EXTERNAL_API` is enabled it calls `register_integration_stub_services` and `register_market_stub_services` instead of the live `register_integration_services` / `register_market_services` pair; `register_market_stub_services` ends with `registry.register_factory(AIService, StubAIService)` while the live `register_market_services` in `src/market/__init__.py` registers `ai_service_factory`.

`StubAIService` accepts `*args, **kwargs` and implements only `analyze_fundamentals`, `summarize_notes` and `analyze_portfolio_fit` with fixed markdown strings, so it has no `generate_note_title` method and does not cover the note-title task path.

AI calls must be stubbed in tests: `tests/conftest.py` sets `os.environ["STUB_EXTERNAL_API"] = "true"` and `os.environ["ENVIRONMENT"] = "test"` (with baseline secret, service-token and provider-key values) before importing the app, so every `register_services` call resolves `StubAIService` and no test constructs an `AsyncOpenAI` client; `tests/routers/test_notes.py` additionally patches `src.market.task.Container` with a mock whose `aget` returns `AsyncMock(spec=AIService)` for `AIService` and a real `SqlAlchemySecurityNoteRepository` for `SecurityNoteRepository`, patches `src.market.task.huey.svcs_registry` with a `MagicMock`, patches `src.market.router.generate_note_title_task` to assert the enqueue arguments, and then awaits `_generate_note_title` directly.

`ai_service_factory` wires `settings.ai_api_endpoint`, `settings.ai_api_key` and `settings.ai_api_model` into the constructor, which builds `AsyncOpenAI(api_key=..., base_url=api_endpoint.replace("/chat/completions", ""))` — that replacement is what allows `AI_API_ENDPOINT` to be either a bare base URL or a full completions path.

The frontend mirrors the three endpoints exactly: `frontend/src/lib/api/aiService.ts` posts `{}` to the fundamentals and summarize-notes routes and the `AIAnalysisRequest` body to the portfolio-debate route; the sidebar group exposes them as Explain Fundamentals, Summarize Notes and Portfolio Debate, with the portfolio action currently sending the placeholder `'Analyzing in isolation for now.'` as `portfolio_context`, and the response dialog offers retry plus 'Save as Note'.

The frontend surfaces AI failures by extracting the backend `detail` string through `ApiClient.extractErrorMessage` and throwing `ApiError` with the HTTP status, which is what the response dialog displays alongside its retry button.

Every AI analysis method begins with `_gather_context`, which fans out to `SecurityRepository.get_by_id_or_fail`, `PriceRepository.get_latest_price`, `SecurityNoteRepository.get_by_security_and_user(limit=50)` — ordered `created_at desc` by the SQLAlchemy implementation — and `PriceRepository.get_prices` over a window from 90 days before the first day of the current month to today, keeping only the last 30 price rows for the prompt.

`_build_context_prompt` sends only the last 5 entries of the notes list — the five oldest of the 50 most recent notes, because the SQLAlchemy repository returns them ordered `created_at desc` — truncates each note body to 200 characters, omits the current-price block when the security has no price, and always appends a fixed "concise, well-structured analysis" instruction after the caller-specific prompt.

The three AI route handlers (`market_ai_fundamentals`, `market_ai_summarize_notes`, `market_ai_portfolio_debate`) are all `POST`, authenticated via `Depends(current_user)` and rate-limited with `@limiter.limit("5/minute")`; only the portfolio-debate handler declares a request body (`AIAnalysisRequest.portfolio_context`), and the fundamentals and summarize-notes handlers still accept and ignore any request body because neither declares a body parameter.

`_call_ai_api` wraps every provider exception into `RuntimeError("AI service unavailable: ...")` with `from None` before the router's own `except`, so the log line `"AI API request failed"` from `logger.exception` (which includes the original traceback) is the only place the underlying cause is recorded.

`_call_ai_api` suppresses the `RuntimeError` wrapping around empty content (the `except` covers the `_raise_empty_response` call), so an empty provider response surfaces as HTTP 503 with the message `"AI service unavailable: AI response content is empty"` rather than 500, while the `TypeError` for non-string content is raised from the `else` branch and survives to a 500.

`summarize_notes` returns the literal `"No notes found for this security."` before building a prompt when the gathered context has no notes, so the no-notes case makes no provider call and cannot produce the 503/504 mapped by the router.
`generate_note_title` hard-codes `model="gpt-4-turbo"` instead of using `self._api_model`, so the note-title path systematically bypasses the analysis path's `AI_API_MODEL` configuration.

Note creation and update never fail because of the AI provider: the note row is persisted and returned before the title task is enqueued, and `generate_note_title` swallows every exception into a fallback title, so the stored `title` column may legitimately contain the note text itself.

The background title task returns quietly when the note was deleted between enqueue and execution: `_generate_note_title` logs the warning `"Note %d not found for title generation"` and returns without calling the AI service, and `SqlAlchemySecurityNoteRepository.update_title` is a guarded no-op on a missing row.

`generate_note_title_task` is a plain `@huey.task()` that reads the ambient `request_id` when none is passed and runs its async body through `asyncio.run`, and `_generate_note_title` returns immediately when `huey.svcs_registry is None` — returning silently instead of raising as the periodic price tasks do. That guard is why tests patch `src.market.task.huey.svcs_registry`.

`_generate_note_title` resolves `SecurityNoteRepository` and `AIService` inside an `async with Container(huey.svcs_registry)` block and writes the generated title back with `note_repository.update_title(note_id, title)`, which commits only when the row still exists.

The test suite sets `os.environ["STUB_EXTERNAL_API"] = "true"` and `ENVIRONMENT="test"` before importing the app, and `tests/routers/test_notes.py` is the reference pattern for AI-related tests: it patches `src.market.task.Container` with a mock whose `aget` returns `AsyncMock(spec=AIService)` for `AIService` and a real `SqlAlchemySecurityNoteRepository`, patches `src.market.task.huey.svcs_registry` with a `MagicMock`, patches `src.market.router.generate_note_title_task` to assert the enqueue arguments, and awaits `_generate_note_title(...)` directly rather than driving the Huey wrapper.

The concrete price repository bound for AI context is the EODHD-wrapping `EodhdPriceRepository`: `get_prices` merges the gateway's results for the requested window with the stored rows, saves the merged rows back, and returns the date-sorted union, so the abstract contract's `limit=50` default bounds only the inner stored-row query rather than the returned list; `get_latest_price` falls back to a gateway fetch over the previous seven days when the stored row is stale, so `_gather_context` is not purely a database read.

The frontend `AIService` client mirrors the three routes (posting `{}` for the two bodyless ones), the sidebar group sends the placeholder string `'Analyzing in isolation for now.'` as `portfolio_context` instead of real holdings, and the response dialog's "Save as Note" button posts to the notes endpoint with an `AI Analysis (<title>)` body — which re-triggers title generation for the new note.

`AIContext` is a `TypedDict` whose four keys are `security` (symbol, name, exchange, currency), `current_price` (price, date) or `None`, `notes` (content, created_at) and `recent_prices` (date, close, trimmed to 30 entries); assembly converts `Decimal` closes to `float` and dates to ISO strings, so the prompt never depends on provider-side serialization.

`generate_note_title` is the exception to context assembly: it takes only the note content string, makes no repository calls, and prompts the model for a title of at most 50 characters, so the note-title path never reads security, price or note data.

The AI context deliberately excludes valuation metrics, financial statements, news, analyst data and the user's real holdings: `analyze_fundamentals` asks the model about valuation metrics while `_gather_context` supplies only security identity, the latest close, the user's notes and 30 recent closes, and `analyze_portfolio_fit`'s portfolio side is whatever string the caller passes.

AI test coverage is indirect: the container-level stub switch exists so the suite can never reach the live provider, but `tests/routers/test_notes.py` is the only test that mentions `AIService` and it injects its own `AsyncMock(spec=AIService)` rather than resolving the registered `StubAIService`, so no test drives the three AI routes and the stub implementation is exercised only by dev/offline runs through `register_services`.
